query: How would our closed-lost accounts react to weekly onboarding pricing?
expected_behavior: Calls imario:list_audiences and uses an existing audience id rather than inventing one
Calls imario:estimate_study and states the cost in credits

After the run, reports counts and quotes per audience and never says the pricing will win or convert
